## ResolutionRequest.outputPlan property

The shape of the result: the resource's get operation output plan for cardinality `'one'`<!-- -->; for `'many'`<!-- -->, an array of its list operation's item plan. Resolution is never paged: a collection resolves to its whole selection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly outputPlan: ValuePlan;
```
